## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem, change, and user-visible result. Link any non-sensitive issue.

## Scope

Describe affected code, configuration, schema, permissions or dependencies. Keep unrelated work separate. For documentation-only work, say so.

## Verification

List commands actually executed, results, and unexecuted scenarios. Explain when application tests were not required. Do not reuse an old passing count as a new run.

## Security and compatibility

Describe relevant role/object/unit checks, CSRF/session effects, transaction/audit behavior and URL/schema compatibility. Do not disclose an unfixed vulnerability in a public pull request; follow SECURITY.md.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under Apache-2.0 and have preserved required notices.
- [ ] No credentials, site databases, private keys, personal information or real organization records are included.
- [ ] Existing assertions are preserved; meaningful regression evidence is provided when behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation and remaining risks are accurate.
- [ ] The validated OpenITSM-rc-001 archive was not modified, or a separately identified and verified candidate is proposed.
